sources.title: YC Essential Startup Advice
sources.applicability: Launch a narrow useful product, learn from users and iterate. This is product discovery advice, not permission to omit safety or integrity.

sources.title: How to Plan an MVP
sources.applicability: YC original lecture; choose a limited initial workflow and feedback loop. The YC library landing page contains no extractable text, so use this original recording.

sources.title: Emerging Architectures for LLM Applications
sources.applicability: 2023 ecosystem analysis. Reuse its separation of data preparation, retrieval, inference and operations; do not reuse old model prices, product rankings or context sizes.

sources.title: What to Look for in Code Review
sources.applicability: Review design, correctness, concurrency, tests and understandability in context. Use evidence for findings rather than style opinions.

sources.title: The Practical Test Pyramid
sources.applicability: Combine fast focused tests with boundary and contract checks; use expensive end-to-end tests for important journeys.

sources.title: Monolith First
sources.applicability: A context-sensitive argument for discovering boundaries before distribution; not a universal ban on services.

sources.title: Canarying Releases
sources.applicability: Use a limited representative population, comparable control, release-specific observations and an actual rollback path.

sources.title: Alerting on SLOs
sources.applicability: Connect actionable alerts to user-visible reliability and budget consumption rather than arbitrary single thresholds.

sources.title: Implementing SLOs
sources.applicability: Define useful service indicators, objectives and agreed error-budget responses around user experience.

sources.title: DORA Software Delivery Performance Metrics
sources.applicability: The current retrieved guide has five metrics. Measure at service level and avoid individual quotas or cross-context league tables. Recheck definitions before use.

sources.title: DORA Test Automation
sources.applicability: Build fast trustworthy feedback and shared ownership of tests; reducing slow feedback matters more than counting tests.

sources.title: DORA Continuous Delivery
sources.applicability: Maintain the ability to release safely on demand. Continuous delivery and automatic production deployment are distinct.

sources.title: WCAG Quick Reference
sources.applicability: Use relevant accessibility success criteria with manual keyboard/focus and assistive-technology checks. Automated scans alone do not establish conformance.

sources.title: Building Effective Agents
sources.applicability: Use simple composable patterns first; distinguish fixed workflows from model-directed agents and account for cost and latency.

sources.title: Demystifying Evals for AI Agents
sources.applicability: Build realistic tasks and reliable graders; evaluate agent trajectories and outcomes, including repeated trials and failure analysis.

sources.title: OWASP Threat Modeling Cheat Sheet
sources.applicability: Model assets, boundaries and threats, select mitigations, then validate them. Threat models evolve with the implementation.

sources.title: OWASP ASVS
sources.applicability: Select versioned security requirements proportional to application risk; the retrieved site offers ASVS 5.0.0. Recheck exact control IDs.

sources.title: NIST Secure Software Development Framework
sources.applicability: Integrate secure development through the lifecycle. Distinguish published final documents and drafts before claiming requirements.

sources.title: Timeouts, Retries, and Backoff with Jitter
sources.applicability: Use time budgets and bounded randomized retries; avoid magnifying overload or repeating unsafe side effects.

sources.title: RFC 9110 HTTP Semantics
sources.applicability: Verify method semantics, retry safety, status codes and validators against the protocol rather than framework folklore.

sources.title: PostgreSQL ALTER TABLE
sources.applicability: Check lock requirements and validation/rewrite behavior for the deployed database version and exact DDL. Current documentation is not necessarily the project version.

sources.title: OpenTelemetry Observability Primer
sources.applicability: Connect signals to system questions; correlate logs, metrics and traces and limit sensitive/high-cardinality data.

sources.title: Google Rules of Machine Learning
sources.applicability: Establish a simple baseline and sound data/serving pipeline; detect training-serving skew and optimize system outcomes.

sources.title: LINDDUN GO
sources.applicability: Use privacy threat prompts for linking, identifying, detecting, disclosure, awareness and compliance; distinguish privacy from access security.

sources.title: SLSA Specification
sources.applicability: Use provenance and build integrity appropriate to the release. Verify specification version and never infer provenance from a passing scan.

sources.title: SPDX Overview
sources.applicability: Describe components and licensing with a recognized interchange model; an SBOM is inventory, not a security or legal guarantee.

sources.title: Semantic Versioning
sources.applicability: Define the public compatibility contract before applying version increments; version numbers alone do not enforce compatibility.

sources.title: GitHub Actions Secure Use
sources.applicability: Limit permissions, protect secrets and treat untrusted workflow input/code carefully. Verify action and runner versions.

sources.title: Superpowers verification
sources.applicability: Completion evidence discipline; Sui independently implements bounded current-input proof, retaining task-sized verification.

sources.title: Historical GSD state template
sources.applicability: Historical continuity template. The former repository redirects to open-gsd/gsd-core; old command names are not asserted current.

sources.title: GitHub Spec Kit
sources.applicability: Separate workflow entry points and connected specifications, plans and tasks; inspected documentation, not a full project audit.

sources.title: BMAD Method
sources.applicability: Task-sized process and durable decisions; reviewed main distinguishes stable and preview, so no current release outcome is inferred.

sources.title: Vercel Agent Skills
sources.applicability: Priority-organized stack-specific guidance; use conditional adapters and independently verified version-specific behavior.

sources.title: Trail of Bits differential review
sources.applicability: Boundary risk and affected-consumer analysis; missing tests are validation gaps rather than automatic vulnerability severity.

sources.title: Anthropic skill creator
sources.applicability: Baseline/candidate behavioral evaluation and trigger testing. Sui implements its own bounded routing scorer; no upstream code copied.
